headline: The customer is waiting on a number. You're still hunting for last time's quote.
Quoting at the kitchen table at 9pm, rebuilding a job you've already priced.
Every quote request lands on you, and every one starts from a blank page.
A slow quote gives the customer time to call someone else.
Your past pricing is saved as assemblies. A new quote starts from what you already know.
Quotes go out while the customer is still thinking about the job.
Same enquiry. Different week.
before: Quotes wait for a free evening and a blank page.
after: Quotes are built from saved assemblies and sent sooner.

headline: Estimate it. Quote it from assemblies. Deliver it. Get paid.
